entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states with support for temporal reasoning. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent context database that organizes memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system—Abstract, Overview, and Details—to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers and multiple storage backends. It achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and offers clients for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform builds searchable knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversation data to provide agents with persistent long-term memory. It runs locally on CPU without requiring LLM API keys and supports custom ontologies for structured data modeling.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider, this engine features a custom vector graph and byte-level deduplication for sub-300ms recall. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and video.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain combines keyword retrieval, semantic search, and a typed knowledge graph to provide synthesis with citations. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over local connections or Tailscale.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed or Docker-based deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider manages context as a git-like repository with versioning for commits, branches, and merges. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms performance, four tiers of which do not require an LLM.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for local storage. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory and structured facts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first traces and outcome-gated context bundles. It provides specific entry points for Hermes and supports various providers including Anthropic and self-hosted vLLM instances.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over 35 coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, without requiring a background server. It enables Hermes Agent to search months of past sessions via MCP or CLI, processing over 19,000 sessions in under 18 seconds.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private, cross-session memory persistence using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server to maintain memory for Hermes Agent.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer syncs state and secrets across multiple AI harnesses, achieving 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports real-time ingestion from external sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to maintain portable agent context.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text files on a local disk for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embeddings, offering an MCP server for tool portability across agents.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: Operating entirely on-device without cloud dependencies, this engine combines vector search, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking for retrieval. It uses a local GGUF observer model to capture session-specific decisions and preferences.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reorders text and multimodal context to facilitate prefix-cache sharing in engines like vLLM and llama.cpp. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling to accelerate inference for Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every recall result. It manages memory integrity by tracking contradictions, preventing duplicates through idempotent writes, and using a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search across coding projects.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI enables agents to autonomously maintain source-grounded wikis with citations, links, and provenance across sessions. The system uses SQLite for storage and supports portable archives for merging wiki data between different environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Designed for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, this anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated client configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory using semantic search through BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search integration.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer stores durable context in plain Markdown for agents like Claude Code and Codex. It manages reviewed context updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts rather than relying on native agent memory.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all memory operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM and Solana chains. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services in a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal. It supports the automatic generation of tool-OKF via detached model calls to assist in capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session and cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots, backed by a local SQLite layer for write reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin facilitates self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It provides specific tools for searching and manual storage, supported by configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory that identifies stale information and contradictions using 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs from plain markdown files, utilizing a local git repository to track and revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while enforcing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It supports multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured software development methodology for agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtimes through DeepSeek Harness and exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features a CLI and optional MCP server that supports incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout adjustments.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill integrates natural-language mandates with ERC-7710 permissions and x402 payments. It functions as a master router that includes escrow, verification, and dispute resolution capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process. It offers five optional voice profiles and three operational modes: rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent interactions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or user accounts. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use across various assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new capabilities via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. The system reports findings alongside a specialized analysis of potential blind spots in the agent's reasoning.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It incorporates a spec review gate that uses PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and utilizes event logging for structured memory.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compliant skills and guides for VPS production, backups, and cron automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations across multiple platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project offers developer tools following the Agent Skills specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills specifically designed for the FLUX 3 video workflow.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It provides integrity verification for execution traces and supports multiple AI model providers through a single Rust binary.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution via a Python client or CLI. It also incorporates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A centralized hub for autonomous resource discovery that allows users to browse, search, and install community skills with one click. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive Model Context Protocol client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses an MCP connection to provide agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that utilizes three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It performs deterministic pre-scans with multiple security tools and verifies findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram to improve quality across five dimensions. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It implements mandatory evidence-based verification gates and uses a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A comprehensive cybersecurity environment that equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks and standards to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports automatic registration of common skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code and Codex. It provides specialized tools for worktree recovery, architectural reviews, and skill scaffolding to support production workflows.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during agent monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal and web applications, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind a multi-layered evaluation system involving deterministic and LLM-judge tests.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills and Claude Code extensions while monitoring official specifications to prevent field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This collection provides skills for CRM management, lead enrichment, and live social data retrieval for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server specifically designed to handle browser-based OAuth authentication workflows.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to assist with e-commerce material creation and document processing.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can correctly navigate environment-specific syntax and verify project-compatible runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols like x402 and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and the OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This quality assurance tool tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill operates as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties over x402. It operates without accounts or API keys, utilizing dedicated wallet keys and user-defined price ceilings for transactions.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It functions via a hosted MCP server compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions, utilizing semantic memory to expand searches based on specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows developers to visualize their consumption and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 40 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 distinct skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring founder approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for schema mismatches or contradictory directions. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and exports findings in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining unique local tools and instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operation using free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configurations, credentials, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the transfer of SOUL.md and skills while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It functions without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for Hermes Agent via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager facilitates one-click switching between API providers for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux to streamline configuration management across multiple agent platforms.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables Hermes Agent to perform autonomous multi-step tasks with file access and user approval. It extends agent accessibility through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram for remote task management.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JS, this interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for web and mobile users. The layout includes a three-panel system for simultaneous chat, session management, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion supports local backends and remote API connections, featuring a streaming chat UI with markdown and token tracking. It provides dedicated management for 14 toolsets, environment profiles, and memory systems.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard offers a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling and approval gates for Hermes and other runtimes. It features unified configuration for 10 communication platforms, including WhatsApp, Matrix, and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex operations. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog for comprehensive skill management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations. It functions as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container with native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes specialized native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside native memory management tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes runtimes for site-aware drafting. It features a bot mode and session-synced chat histories with opt-in browser control via Hermes Assist.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and optional private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for monitoring latency and token usage alongside a live workspace for tracking code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that indexes local agent histories to allow searching through prompts, tool calls, and command outputs. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs without uploading telemetry or session data.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management and includes a kanban board for tracking agentic work and tasks.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring installation or admin rights. It includes a workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It integrates a file browser and task tracking dashboard with management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes. Users can inspect conversation histories and skill source code or perform read-only monitoring of environment variables and configurations.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming, tool approval cards, and isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering and installing new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
